name: ui-select-tick
prompt: Short soft wooden tick, like a fingertip tapping the edge of a playing card.

name: card-select-snap
prompt: A single playing card snapped lightly against a felt card table.

name: chip-select-click
prompt: A small plastic game chip clicking once on a wooden table.

name: card-play-slide
prompt: A playing card sliding across green felt and coming to a stop.

name: card-place-thump
prompt: A playing card placed firmly onto a table with a soft paper thump.

name: card-flip-snap
prompt: A playing card flipped face-up with a quick crisp snap.

name: deck-draw-whoosh
prompt: A single card drawn quickly from the top of a deck, soft paper whoosh.

name: deck-draw-slide
prompt: A card pulled slowly off a deck with a dry paper sliding sound.

name: deck-tap-draw
prompt: A card deck tapped once on the table followed by one card being drawn.

name: wild-eight-chime
prompt: A bright magical chime accent for playing a wild card, shimmering and short.

name: action-whoosh-shimmer
prompt: A quick airy whoosh with a shimmering sparkling tail, like a spell cast.

name: action-zap-pop
prompt: A short cartoonish electric zap ending in a small pop.

name: win-fanfare-brass
prompt: A short triumphant brass fanfare burst celebrating a round victory.

name: win-chime-arpeggio
prompt: A rising happy chime arpeggio, cheerful and bright.

name: win-applause-brief
prompt: A small crowd giving a brief warm applause swell.

name: lose-soft-descend
prompt: A short gentle descending three-note woodwind phrase, wistful but warm, like losing a friendly card game.

name: invalid-felt-thud
prompt: A soft muted double tap of a fingertip on a felt card table, a polite not-allowed thud, no harshness.

name: undo-card-slide-back
prompt: A playing card sliding backwards across felt and being picked up again, a quick reverse swish.

name: turn-glass-bell
prompt: A single soft bright glass bell ding, short and clean, signalling it is your turn.

name: penalty-cards-flurry
prompt: A quick flurry of several playing cards dealt rapidly onto a table one after another, papery.

name: onecard-knock-alert
prompt: Two quick knuckle knocks on a wooden card table, an alert that someone has one card left.

name: hint-soft-sparkle
prompt: A soft short sparkle shimmer, like a small glint of light, gentle and quiet.

name: achievement-warm-chime
prompt: A warm rising two-chord chime with a soft bell resolve, celebratory but understated.

name: shuffle-deck-riffle
prompt: A deck of playing cards riffle shuffled once and squared up on a felt table.
